restrictedTokens.rule: Tokens marked restricted (internal shader constants) are never valid in a PageSpec.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no #hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or named colours in token slots
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no px/rem/em/% literals: use spacing.* tokens
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: only typography.family.* tokens (Satoshi stack, UI stack, digits stack)

overrides: PageSpec nodes may carry an optional `tokens` object (slot -> token id). There is no other style override mechanism; section contracts own all other styling.
